summary: Master data collection and analysis techniques tailored for MEAL professionals. Our training equips you with essential skills to improve project outcomes.
lede: Data collection and analysis for MEAL helps monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning professionals turn project information into evidence for decisions. Participants practice designing indicators and surveys, managing mobile data workflows, and analyzing quantitative and qualitative findings. They also develop dashboards and reports to communicate results to stakeholders and support project learning and accountability.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for demonstrating project impact and ensuring organizational accountability through rigorous data systems.
modules: Foundations of MEAL and Theory of Change
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management cycles. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel (basic formulas and data entry) is required. No prior experience with KoboToolbox or Power BI is necessary, as these will be covered from a foundational level.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
